rationale: UN official warns of toughest winter since full-scale invasion with power and water access at risk; Canada offers air defense support; Saudi pipeline closure affects global energy markets indirectly.

top_events.title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
